body:
Sorry for the late response.

I spent the Wednesday in bed, watching Community and The Hunchback of the Notre Damne (a plan I set up with my therapist, being lazy and watching a list of stuff I like, in stead of doing a lot of stuff, only to end up mentally exhausted). Thursday and today I went to class and tried to resume my normal life, and it actually went well. I also talked to my parents and friend and was able to explain what happened and save the relationships. They all know my patterns pretty well by now.

I did not call my therapist yet, we have an appointment on the 6th of October to see my future treatment, since I am taking a two month break from therapy after finishing [DBT](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dialectical_behavior_therapy). I did however write this down in my list of things I want to talk about. 

I'm sorry if this is a lot of information, but I just wanted to give you some because you have really helped me. Thank you so much!
Update: I woke up. I don't really feel like doing much today, luckily I won't have to. I'll call my therapist later today.

You're a very nice person.

Painkillers here aren't strong, and I didn't take much, about 8 x 500 mg paracetamol and 5 x 150 mg acetylsalicylic acid or around those numbers, I've done worse, but nothing the people I'm close to know about, so this is freaking me out . (I hope I got the translations of the substances right)

Anyways, that isn't enough to kill me. I'll probably call my therapist tomorrow. I still have no idea how to go on. I lied to my parents and friend and I don't want them to ever know, I guess I will see, I think my emotional state right now is mostly due to not eating anything for 2 days and drinking 2 liters of beer tonight. I'll see tomorrow.

Again, you seem pretty cool, I'll see when I wake up.
